name: application-task-checklist
title: Task Checklist
description: Checkable task list with real toggle state, a computed "N/M complete" progress count, and an add-item input — distinct from the onboarding-focused onboarding-checklist.
useWhen: Tracking a flat list of checkable tasks (a launch checklist, a to-do list) with a running completion count.
Users need to add new items to the list inline, without navigating to a separate form.
The completion count should always reflect the real checked/unchecked state, not a hand-typed fraction.
avoidWhen: The checklist is a one-time onboarding/setup flow with its own dismiss and progress-ring styling — use onboarding-checklist instead.
Tasks need nested subtasks or hierarchy — extend the data model before reusing this flat-list markup.
You need drag-to-reorder — this component only supports check/uncheck and append.
responsiveBehavior: The list and input row are a single-column block that reflows naturally to any container width.
accessibility: Each task uses a real <label>/<input type="checkbox"> pair so the whole row is a clickable, keyboard-operable target.
Completed tasks are shown with both a checked checkbox and strikethrough text, not strikethrough alone.
The progress count ("N/M complete") is visible text recalculated from the real items array on every toggle.

variants.title: Task checklist
variants.description: Five-item launch checklist with three completed tasks (3/5 complete) and an add-task input, on a light surface.
accessibility: Pressing Enter in the add-task input submits the new item, matching native form-field conventions.

variants.title: Task checklist (Dark)
variants.description: The same five-item launch checklist, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Checkbox, text, and input colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
